content.text: {"subject":"Math","explanation":"Two-digit addition means adding numbers from 10 to 99. The key is to line them up by place value (ones below ones, tens below tens), add the ones column first, then the tens column. If ones add to 10 or more, carry the extra ten to the tens column. Help your child practise with examples like 23 + 15 and 27 + 18 to see the carrying in action.","quiz":[{"question":"What is 34 + 23?","options":["57","47","67","56"],"correct":0,"explain":"Add ones: 4+3=7. Add tens: 3+2=5. Answer is 57.","category":"skill_based"},{"question":"If you add 25 + 17, what happens in the ones column?","options":["5+7=12, so you write 2 and carry 1","5+7=12, so you write 12","5+1=6","2+1=3"],"correct":0,"explain":"5+7=12, which is more than 10, so you write the 2 in ones place and carry 1 ten to the tens column.","category":"understanding"},{"question":"When adding 19 + 14, why do we carry a number?","options":["Because 9+4 makes 13, which is more than 10","Because 1+1 makes 2","Because 9 is a large number","Because we always carry"],"correct":0,"explain":"9+4=13, which has a ten and three ones; the ten must move to the tens place.","category":"understanding"},{"question":"Asha has 28 stickers. Her friend gives her 15 more. How many stickers does Asha have now?","options":["43","42","33","53"],"correct":0,"explain":"Add 28+15: ones are 8+5=13 (carry 1), tens are 2+1+1=4, so 43 stickers.","category":"application"},{"question":"If you add two-digit numbers and the ones column gives you 10, what do you do?","options":["Write 0 in ones place and carry 1 to tens","Write 10 in ones place","Start over","Write 1 in ones place and carry 0"],"correct":0,"explain":"When ones sum to exactly 10, write 0 in the ones place and carry 1 ten to the tens column.","category":"skill_based"}]}
